component.name: google-bigquery-sql
component.title: Google BigQuery Standard SQL
component.description: Run SQL queries and statements in Google BigQuery.
component.label: cloud,messaging

connectionFactory.description: The org.apache.camel.component.google.bigquery.GoogleBigQueryConnectionFactory that provides the BigQuery client for the endpoints that do not set their own connectionFactory.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

projectId.description: The ID of a Google Cloud project. Not used: an endpoint takes the project ID from its URI.

autowiredEnabled.label: advanced
autowiredEnabled.description: Whether autowiring is enabled. This is used for automatic autowiring options (the option must be marked as autowired) by looking up in the registry to find if there is a single instance of matching type, which then gets configured on the component. This can be used for automatic configuring JDBC data sources, JMS connection factories, AWS Clients, etc.

CamelGoogleBigQueryTranslatedQuery.description: The query that the producer sends to BigQuery, after it has replaced the ${name} placeholders. The producer sets it.

CamelGoogleBigQueryJobId.description: The ID of a query job. When set, the producer does not run the query but waits for this job and returns its result, for example to read the next page with the CamelGoogleBigQueryPageToken header. The producer sets it after a SELECT with the SELECT_LIST output type.

CamelGoogleBigQueryPageToken.description: The token of the page of SELECT results to return, from the CamelGoogleBigQueryNextPageToken header of a previous call. It replaces the pageToken option. Send it with the CamelGoogleBigQueryJobId header of that call, so the page is read from the same job.

CamelGoogleBigQueryNextPageToken.description: The token of the next page of SELECT results, or null for the last page. The producer sets it with the SELECT_LIST output type. Send it in the CamelGoogleBigQueryPageToken header to read the next page.

producerIn.description: The query is set on the endpoint. A Map body gives the values of the @name parameters, before the headers of the same name; any other body is ignored

producerOut.description: For a SELECT the rows of the page, a Map per row whose scalar values are the text BigQuery returns, with the next page token and the job id in headers; with outputType=STREAM_LIST an Iterator of those Maps over all pages. For a DML statement the number of affected rows as a Long, and no body for another statement, such as DDL (CREATE TABLE), which has no such number

projectId.label: common
projectId.description: The ID of the Google Cloud project that runs the query jobs. The endpoint also sets it as the project of the BigQuery client that it creates.

queryString.label: common
queryString.description: The GoogleSQL (standard SQL) query or statement to run, or a resource with the query, such as classpath:query.sql, loaded when the producer starts. A named query parameter takes its value from the entry of that name of a Map body, else from the header of that name, and a ${name} placeholder is replaced by the text of the header or exchange property of that name.

connectionFactory.description: The org.apache.camel.component.google.bigquery.GoogleBigQueryConnectionFactory that provides the BigQuery client. If not set, the connectionFactory of the component is used, and if that is not set either, the endpoint creates one from the serviceAccountKey and projectId options.

outputType.label: producer
outputType.description: How the producer returns the rows of a SELECT. SELECT_LIST returns one page as a List of Maps, with the CamelGoogleBigQueryNextPageToken and CamelGoogleBigQueryJobId headers. STREAM_LIST returns an Iterator of Maps that fetches all the pages while it is read, and sets no header.

pageSize.label: producer
pageSize.description: The maximum number of rows in a page of SELECT results. With 0 or less, BigQuery chooses the page size.

pageToken.label: producer
pageToken.description: The token of the page of SELECT results to return, from the CamelGoogleBigQueryNextPageToken header of a previous call. If not set, the first page is returned. The CamelGoogleBigQueryPageToken header replaces it.

lazyStartProducer.label: producer,advanced
lazyStartProducer.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

serviceAccountKey.label: security
serviceAccountKey.description: The location of the JSON key file of the service account to authenticate with Google Cloud, such as a classpath:, file: or https: resource, or base64: followed by the Base64 encoded content of the file. If not set, Application Default Credentials are used. It is not used when a connectionFactory is set.
